fundingfade.summary: Buys crowded-short reversions: funding 1 sigma under its 500-period mean, first green candle, ADX>25, volume spike, BTC bull gate.
fundingfade.entry: funding_below_mean (funding rate < 500-period rolling mean - 1 std, fail-closed if funding data stale >12h) AND price_reversal (green candle with close > prior close) AND ADX(14) > 25 AND volume > 1.5x SMA20(volume) AND btc_gate == 1. btc_gate (macro gate v2): BTC 1h close > SMA50 AND > SMA200 AND SMA50 24-bar slope > 0 AND NOT regime halt (BTC 30d return < 0 AND BTC 30d mean funding > 0); gate fails closed on missing/stale BTC funding or history.
fundingfade.exit: ROI ladder 8% -> 5% @360m -> 3% @720m -> 2% @1440m; no trailing; hard stop -4.5%; no dataframe signal exit; custom_exit: v2_failed_reversion at 96h if underwater, v2_expired_episode at 168h if profit < 1%.
fundingfade.risk: stoploss -0.045; gate-v2 3.3yr backtest maxDD 2.40% (vs 3.91% baseline), P(MaxDD < baseline) = 92.5% (block-bootstrap, 1000 iter, 30d blocks). Header caveat: combined gate was meta-selected (~4 effective dof); deploy reason is risk reduction, not return uplift.
fundingfade.provenance: Repo-native lab strategy (generated 2026-04-17); macro gate v2 added 2026-05-19 after a Codex-reviewed protocol and a 5-SL live streak.

keltner.summary: Buys 1h spot bounces off the Keltner lower band on a volume spike, only while BTC trades above its own 50-period SMA.
keltner.entry: close crosses above kelt_lower (SMA25 - 2.5*ATR25: prior close <= prior band, current close > band) AND volume > 1.75x SMA20(volume) AND btc_gate == 1 (BTC 1h close > BTC SMA50) AND volume > 0.
keltner.exit: ROI ladder 10% -> 7% @360m -> 4% @720m -> 2% @1440m; trailing +3% from +5% offset (only after offset); hard stop -6%; no dataframe signal exit (exit_profit_only with +1% offset); custom_exit closes underwater trades at 120h (v2_stale_bounce).
keltner.risk: stoploss -0.06, tightened from -0.07 in live v2: 'the forward sample showed that losing trades never recovered after reaching the old -7% floor, while winners had materially smaller adverse excursions.'
keltner.provenance: Repo-native Strategy Lab grid scan on 3.3 years of 1m-detail data (Jan 2023 - Apr 2026), cross-validated against Freqtrade's own 1m-detail backtest.

oi-trend.summary: Buys 1h spot trend continuations: EMA20 reclaim inside a 50/200 uptrend with live futures open interest not contracting.
oi-trend.entry: Conjunction of named terms: uptrend_50_200 (EMA50 > EMA200), above_ema200, above_ema20, reclaim_ema20 (prior close <= prior EMA20), near_ema20_2pct (close <= EMA20*1.02), rsi_45_68 (RSI(14) in [45,68]), volume_1_10x (> 1.10x SMA20), oi_growth >= oi_min_growth (0.0 = OI not contracting over ~45 min, live poll, fail-closed), btc_trend (BTC 1h close > EMA200 AND BTC EMA50 > EMA200).
oi-trend.exit: ROI ladder 6% -> 4% @360m -> 2.5% @720m -> 1% @1440m; trailing +2.5% from +4% offset; hard stop -5%; no dataframe signal exit; custom_exit ema50_break closes after a completed candle closes below EMA50 (candle open-time must postdate trade open).
oi-trend.risk: stoploss -0.05 (not on exchange in config); live record: zero trades since 2026-08-23 under both the old 2% and current 0% OI gates; the gate's profitability claim was withdrawn (prereg oi-gate-recalibration-2026-08-30) and the bot runs dry.
oi-trend.provenance: Repo-native forward-only spot strategy; its OI gate depends on live Binance Futures public data, so there is no transferable historical baseline.

short-keltner-hl.summary: Shorts 1h Hyperliquid perps fading upper-Keltner rejections on volume spikes, only in a confirmed multi-timeframe BTC bear regime.
short-keltner-hl.entry: close crosses back below kelt_upper (SMA25 + 2.5*ATR25) AND volume > 1.75x SMA20(volume) AND RSI(14) was > 60 on bar -1 or -2 AND btc_bear == 1. btc_bear macro gate (all four, fails closed on NaN inputs with a watchdog log): BTC 1h close < SMA50 AND < SMA200 AND SMA50 24-bar slope < 0 AND 1h close < daily SMA200.
short-keltner-hl.exit: ROI ladder 6% -> 4% @360m -> 2.5% @720m -> 1.5% @1440m -> 0% @2160m; no trailing; hard stop -5% (live config adds an exchange-resident limit stop); signal exit regime_flip_or_oversold (BTC 1h close > SMA50 OR RSI < 30); custom_exit time_exit_36h force-closes shorts at 36h.
short-keltner-hl.risk: stoploss -0.05, leverage capped at 2x; at 2x leverage the first ROI rung is a -3.00% price move and the stop a +2.50% price move. Documented fatal property: 4 signals in 20 months (~0.20/month); macro gate open only 18.1% of hours.
short-keltner-hl.provenance: Repo-native Hyperliquid (USDC-margined) port of ShortKeltnerV2 (generated 2026-05-29), identical logic except the BTC informative venue; forward-measured, no historical downloads exist for HL.

killers-ft.summary: Copy-trader: entries come from the Binance Killers VIP Telegram channel via the receiver; the bot itself computes no signals.
killers-ft.entry: No TA entry conditions (populate_entry_trend writes zeros). The receiver gates the classified Telegram signal before /forceenter: posted SL required and unbreached, mark fetch (fail-closed), max_open cap, 3% entry-slippage gate (rests a limit at the zone edge), target guard, fixed stop-risk sizing, then POST /forceenter with the stop embedded in entry_tag.
killers-ft.exit: Receiver-driven: channel closes arrive via /forceexit (equal TP ladder, legacy mode); custom_stoploss turns the posted stop into Freqtrade's exchange-resident absolute stop, recomputed from the same absolute price every tick so it never becomes a trailing stop; ROI ceiling disabled (minimal_roi 100); -7% catastrophe floor beneath the posted stop.
killers-ft.risk: stoploss -0.07 catastrophe floor only; real risk is the signal's posted SL with fixed stop-risk sizing (our instance: risk $12, max margin $40, leverage cap 3, max_open 5, 25% MaxDD pause trigger per prereg killers-equal-ladder-2026-09-30).
killers-ft.provenance: Copy-trader of the external Binance Killers VIP Telegram channel, executed on Hyperliquid via the repo's observer -> classifier -> receiver pipeline; evidence base in .local/internal-docs/strategies/01-killers-scalp.md and 07-signal-pipeline.md.

insiders-ft.summary: Copy-trader: entries come from Dennis's free Market Mastery Telegram channel via the receiver; the bot itself computes no signals.
insiders-ft.entry: No TA entry conditions (populate_entry_trend is a pass-through). The receiver applies the same gate chain (max_open, posted-SL checks, mark fetch, slippage, sizing) to Dennis's terse $SYM LONG posts classified by the rules/LLM classifier, then /forceenter; unlike killers, bump-to-min is OFF so sub-minimum entries skip rather than raise risk.
insiders-ft.exit: Receiver-driven: the receiver closes positions via /forceexit; custom_stoploss pulls the live per-trade SL from the receiver's position graph (60s cache, 500ms timeout, wrong-side SL rejected and static stop kept); ROI disabled (minimal_roi 100); -10% static safety net.
insiders-ft.risk: stoploss -0.10 static safety net; actual risk is the receiver's per-signal posted stop with fixed sizing (our instance: risk $1.5, max margin $10, leverage 3). Prior paid-path backtest verdict was negative (-8.7%/-13%); this epoch is a live falsifiable re-test on the free channel.
insiders-ft.provenance: Copy-trader of Dennis's free 'Market Mastery' Telegram channel fed by the observer fan-out, same receiver image and KillersScalpV1 executor pattern under the Insiders config; see .local/internal-docs/strategies/02-insiders-scalp.md and 07-signal-pipeline.md.

test-bollinger.summary: Test-lane 15m mean reversion: dips below the lower Bollinger band with oversold RSI in ranging, non-crashing markets.
test-bollinger.entry: close < bb_lowerband AND rsi < 30 AND adx < 30 (ranging only) AND regime_volatile == 0 AND bb_width > 0.02 (avoid squeezes) AND volume > volume_sma AND btc_not_crashing (BTC 1h RSI > 25) AND not btc_crashing (no >2% BTC drop in 4h). confirm_trade_entry additionally blocks on Fear&Greed extremes and cross-bot pair crowding (market_intelligence).
test-bollinger.exit: ROI ladder 4% -> 2.5% @30m -> 1.5% @60m -> 1% floor @120m; trailing 1% from 2% offset; hard stop -5%; signal exit close > bb_middleband OR rsi > 65 OR volatility spike (regime_atr_14 > 2.5x regime_atr_sma_50); custom_exit time_exit_24h force-closes at 24h.
test-bollinger.risk: stoploss -0.05; source comment: 'Data: 0% of trades recover past -7%, 92% of winners never dip past -3%'.
test-bollinger.provenance: Repo-native test-lane strategy (imports repo-local market_intelligence for the Fear&Greed and cross-bot position guards); machinery exerciser, never a measurement epoch.

test-nasos.summary: Test-lane 5m community dip-buy: price under an offset EMA with Elliott Wave oscillator extremes, in calm ranging regimes.
test-nasos.entry: Multi-condition dip-buy with three tagged arms: ewo1 (close < EMA(8)*0.983 AND EWO > 3.553 AND rsi < 78 AND rsi_fast < 37), ewo2 (deeper offset 0.942, EWO > -5.585, rsi < 25), ewolow (EWO < -14.378); all require close < EMA(16)*1.069, volume > 0, regime_volatile == 0, regime_trending == 0, and a lookback veto (15m rolling max < close * 1.037 blocks entry).
test-nasos.exit: ROI 0% @360m (exit flat after 6h); no trailing - custom_stoploss ladder instead: force close >8h, -3% from open >4h, ATRx2 stop >2h, profit locks up to 5% above +30%; hard stop -8%; signal exit in populate_exit_trend (close > sma_9 / ma_sell offsets with rsi_fast > rsi_slow), with a confirm_trade_exit veto in downtrends and slippage protection.
test-nasos.risk: stoploss -0.08; source comment: 'MAE data: 95% of winners recovered from -5.29% or less'; custom_stoploss cites '93% of winners close in <50min' as the basis for time tightening.
test-nasos.provenance: Community strategy; file header credits @Rallipanos, @pluxury with help from @stash86 and @Perkmeister.

test-elliot.summary: Test-lane 5m community dip-buy: offset-EMA discount with EWO high or deep-low extremes, in calm non-trending regimes.
test-elliot.entry: close < EMA(17)*0.978 AND (EWO > 3.34 AND rsi < 60, OR EWO < -17.457) AND volume > 0 AND regime_volatile == 0 AND regime_trending == 0.
test-elliot.exit: ROI ladder 21.5% -> 13.2% @40m -> 8.6% @87m -> 3% @201m; trailing 0.5% from 3% offset; hard stop -8%; custom_stoploss time tightening (force close >8h, -3% from open >4h, ATRx2 stop >2h); signal exit close > EMA(39)*1.011.
test-elliot.risk: stoploss -0.08; source comment: 'MAE data: 95% of winners recovered from -4.95% or less'; custom_stoploss cites '93% of winners close in <50min'.
test-elliot.provenance: In-repo community strategy (per the app.py test-lane note); the file itself carries no author credits.

test-combined.summary: Test-lane 5m mean reversion combining BinHV45 volatility squeeze and ClucMay72018 deep Band touch, in ranging markets.
test-combined.entry: BinHV45 arm (bbdelta > close*0.008 AND closedelta > close*0.0175 AND tail < bbdelta*0.25 AND close < prior 40-period lower band AND close <= prior close) OR ClucMay72018 arm (close < ema_slow AND close < 0.985*bb_lowerband AND volume < 20x prior volume_mean_slow); both gated by regime_volatile == 0 AND regime_trending == 0 (ADX < 25).
test-combined.exit: ROI flat 5%; no trailing; hard stop -5%; signal exit close > bb_middleband OR volatility spike (regime_atr_14 > 2.5x regime_atr_sma_50); exit_profit_only with +1% offset.
test-combined.risk: stoploss -0.05; no data-driven comment in the source file.
test-combined.provenance: Community combination of the BinHV45 and ClucMay72018 strategies (freqtrade-strategies lineage); in-repo test lane.
